architecture.mechanism: Integrated multi-source energy harvesting architecture to generate power for onboard systems independent of external infrastructure.
architecture.intervention: Install a dedicated low-power energy harvester (e.g., vibration or ambient RF) on the 12V battery bus to continuously offset parasitic drain from spurious RF activations, ensuring net-positive charge balance during parking without disabling the receiver.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of battery depletion caused by unintended electrical activation while maintaining full functionality of keyless-entry and security systems.
architecture.falsification_test: Park the vehicle in a controlled RF-noise environment simulating spurious triggers for 72 hours; measure 12V battery state-of-charge with the harvester active versus a control unit without the harvester.
